headline: New 'Alignment Plausibility' Framework Proposed for Assuring AI Safety in Healthcare
reasoning: This paper introduces a novel and critical framework, 'Alignment Plausibility,' directly addressing AI safety and ethical deployment in the high-stakes healthcare sector, particularly for LLMs providing mental health support. Its focus on structural safety, value specification, training, and oversight offers a substantive, research-backed approach to a pressing AI challenge, moving beyond reactive measures. The analogy to 'biological plausibility' for regulatory purposes adds significant technical credibility and potential for real-world impact.
summary: Researchers propose 'Alignment Plausibility' as a new standard for assuring AI safety in healthcare, outlining a three-level framework for structural alignment of LLMs based on clinical practice norms, training, and oversight to prevent long-term harms.

source_articles.title: Alignment Plausibility: A New Standard for Assuring AI in Healthcare
